content:
Lina: Opening a tiny docs PR to collapse the optimize toolkit examples into a single 'patterns' section (batching vs kv-prefetch vs prefix), plus SDK snippet parity. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4510

Omar: Nice. Two asks: add a short migration callout for the old quant names, and normalize YAML examples so `batch_size: "auto"`.

Lina: Will do. Migration note will say: QuantProfile.ShortSeq -> QuantProfiles.short_sequence() and recommend builder-style snippets across SDKs.

Felix: Also saw a broken anchor in kv-prefetch (old #prefetch). qa-bot flagged it. Replace with #kv-prefetch-policy and add default TTL note (hosted:10m).

qa-bot: Link scan result: 1 broken anchor -> docs/optimize/kv-prefetch.md#prefetch. Suggested fix: #kv-prefetch-policy.

Omar: Can you include one-line Rust + JS snippets, mirror the Python/Go builder pattern? Keeps parity for infra teams.

Lina: Yep — tiny Rust line and JS builder example included. Keeping the thread short; pushing in ~15m and will request reviews from @Omar and @Felix. :rocket:
